name: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation
definition: A process to adapt the pre-trained MDE network to the specific scene's absolute geometry using NeRF as a prior, resolving ambiguities like convexity/concavity and orientation.
summary: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation fine-tunes a monocular depth network using a NeRF as a geometric prior, distinguishing itself by explicitly adapting the depth estimator rather than merely regularizing the NeRF.
